name: wx-mp-core
description: Generic building blocks for WeChat Mini Programs — HTTP wrapper, auth, UI tokens, helpers.
notes: Consumed as a git submodule — see README.md. No `npm install` step is needed for consumers.
Each module is also require()-able directly: `require('wx-mp-core/src/http')`.
No transpile step. Source is plain ES5/CommonJS compatible with the WeChat developer tools.
